connectors.name: Perplexity MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Gives Claude Code live internet access through Perplexity search, so answers reflect the current web. Useful for up-to-date research while coding.
connectors.install_or_source: MCP server (add to Claude Code config)

connectors.name: Playwright MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Lets Claude Code drive a real browser: navigate, click, fill forms, run tests and upload files. Turns the agent into a browser operator.

connectors.name: Firecrawl MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Crawls and scrapes entire websites into clean text for RAG and context. Handles JS-heavy pages and can bypass many captchas.

connectors.name: Glyph MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Claude Code to image and video generation models and optimizes the prompts sent to them. Acts as a bridge to media-gen backends.
connectors.paid_version: depends on the connected media model

connectors.name: Chrome MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Lets Claude interact with your already-open Chrome browser, reading tabs and acting on the current page. Handy for working inside logged-in sessions.

connectors.name: Hostinger MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Gives Claude 118 tools to deploy and manage hosting: spin up a VPS, manage domains and ship sites without leaving the agent. Effectively a deployment backend for Claude.

connectors.name: Viralo
connectors.what_it_does: A custom Claude connector that streams real-time data on 4M+ short-form videos across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts. Lets Claude spot and ride current trends for content.
connectors.install_or_source: Add as a custom connector in Claude: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector (paste the Viralo URL + API key)

connectors.name: Gemini AI MCP Server (Bhansalisoft)
connectors.what_it_does: An MCP server hosted on Apify that exposes Gemini AI capabilities to automation and agent workflows. It allows other tools to call Gemini via the MCP protocol.

connectors.name: Higgsfield MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Claude, ChatGPT, and other LLMs to Higgsfield AI's marketing platform, enabling trend research, content planning, batch UGC video generation, and Meta Ads scheduling from a single chat session.

connectors.name: Figma AI MCP Server (Bhansalisoft)
connectors.what_it_does: An MCP server on Apify that connects Figma to AI automation workflows, enabling AI-assisted design processing. Details are limited in the source video.

connectors.name: Metricool MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Claude to Metricool's social media management platform, enabling scheduling posts, pulling analytics, finding best posting times, and analyzing competitors across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, Meta Ads, and Google Ads — all from one Claude chat.
connectors.install_or_source: Add as a connector in Claude settings (Metricool MCP)

connectors.name: Manus Gmail Connector
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Manus AI to Gmail, enabling the agent to draft and send emails directly from the user's inbox as part of automated lead outreach or deal re-engagement workflows.
connectors.install_or_source: Available natively within Manus AI — connect via Manus connectors settings

connectors.name: Manus Google Calendar Connector
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Manus AI to Google Calendar, enabling the agent to read events, create calendar blocks, and run automated calendar audits with Slack reporting on a defined schedule.
connectors.install_or_source: Available natively within Manus AI — connect via Manus connectors settings

connectors.name: Manus Telegram Connector
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Manus AI to Telegram, providing a mobile-accessible chat interface that supports voice, text, and image inputs and enables proactive agent-initiated morning briefings.
connectors.install_or_source: Available natively within Manus AI — connect via Manus connectors settings

connectors.name: Alexa + Claude Integration
connectors.what_it_does: Amazon Alexa voice assistant powered by Anthropic Claude, enabling multi-turn dialogue, complex task handling, and persistent cross-session memory via voice.

connectors.name: Claude Code Channels — Telegram
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Telegram to a running Claude Code session via the Channels feature, allowing users to push messages and instructions into the agent from the Telegram app without returning to Claude interface.

connectors.name: Claude Code Channels — Discord
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Discord to a running Claude Code session via the Channels feature, allowing messages from Discord servers or DMs to reach the Claude Code agent directly.

connectors.name: Claude for Small Business
connectors.what_it_does: Official Claude connector that enables Claude chat to manage business emails (draft, triage, summarize), schedule calendar meetings and focus time, and answer questions from project documents. Chains with CRM connectors for full customer context.
connectors.install_or_source: Open Claude > Customize > search Claude for small business > click + to install > add individual tool connectors

connectors.name: Recall Chrome extension
connectors.what_it_does: Saves web content such as podcasts, YouTube videos, TikToks, websites, and PDFs directly into the user's Recall knowledge base.

connectors.name: Claude Co-work Slack Integration
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Claude Co-work to Slack to enable automated scraping and summarization of Slack conversations.

connectors.name: Claude Co-work Notion Integration
connectors.what_it_does: Allows Claude Co-work to update Notion databases automatically with summarized data.

connectors.name: Expo MCP Server
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Claude Code to Expo's iOS/Android simulator infrastructure, allowing agents to autonomously build, run, and test React Native mobile apps without human intervention.
connectors.install_or_source: Expo MCP server — check Expo docs / npm for install

connectors.name: RevenueCat MCP Server
connectors.what_it_does: Allows Claude Code agents to configure in-app purchases and subscription pricing in RevenueCat autonomously, without manual dashboard interaction.

connectors.name: App Store Connect MCP Server
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Claude Code agents to Apple's App Store Connect to autonomously configure app metadata, pricing tiers, and submission information.
connectors.install_or_source: App Store Connect MCP — search GitHub for app-store-connect-mcp

connectors.name: Context7 MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Fetches live, version-specific documentation from official library sources and injects it into AI prompts — add 'use context7' to any prompt to get accurate, up-to-date code examples for React, Next.js, and 500+ frameworks without hallucinated APIs.

connectors.name: Bright Data MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Gives AI agents full access to Bright Data's proxy and scraping stack — Web Unlocker, SERP API, and Scraping Browser — enabling fresh, geo-specific web extraction with automatic CAPTCHA bypass from any MCP client.

connectors.name: GitHub MCP Server
connectors.what_it_does: Official GitHub MCP that gives AI agents full access to GitHub — read repos, manage issues and PRs, search code, analyze changes, and automate workflows without leaving Claude or any MCP client.

connectors.name: MCP Toolbox for Databases
connectors.what_it_does: Google's open-source MCP server that connects AI agents to enterprise databases — handles authentication, connection pooling, and schema introspection so agents can query PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and other databases directly.

connectors.name: Memory MCP Server
connectors.what_it_does: Official Anthropic MCP server that maintains a persistent knowledge graph of entities and relationships across sessions — so Claude can remember user context, facts, and preferences between separate conversations.

connectors.name: Sequential Thinking MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Anthropic MCP server that guides Claude through structured, sequential reasoning chains — ideal for architectural decisions, multi-step debugging, and complex planning where explicit step-by-step thought improves output quality.

connectors.name: Exa MCP
connectors.what_it_does: The most-used search MCP in 2026 — wraps Exa's semantic (neural) search API so AI agents can perform concept-level web search, find similar content, filter by news/code/company, and retrieve clean full-text results without keyword matching.

connectors.name: E2B MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Secure, isolated code execution sandboxes for AI agents — lets Claude safely run Python, JavaScript, bash, and other code in the cloud with filesystem access and package installation support without local execution risk.
connectors.free_tokens: free sandbox hours on developer plan

connectors.name: Browserbase MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Cloud headless browser automation MCP for AI agents — provides managed, scalable browser sessions with session recording, live debugging, and CAPTCHA handling so agents can scrape, click, and interact with any website.

connectors.name: Databox MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Plugs Databox business KPI dashboards into Claude via MCP — lets AI agents query real-time metrics from Google Analytics, HubSpot, Salesforce, and 70+ other sources without leaving the chat interface.

connectors.name: Cal.com MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Official Cal.com MCP that gives AI agents calendar and scheduling access — create events, check availability, manage bookings, and handle meeting logistics from Claude without opening the Cal.com dashboard.
connectors.paid_version: Cal.com paid plans for advanced scheduling

connectors.name: Cloudflare MCP
connectors.what_it_does: Official Cloudflare MCP that lets AI agents deploy and manage Cloudflare resources — Workers, KV, R2, D1 databases, and DNS — from Claude without opening the Cloudflare dashboard.
connectors.paid_version: Cloudflare paid plans for production usage

connectors.name: Anki MCP
connectors.what_it_does: MCP server connecting Claude to the Anki flashcard application — AI agents can create, read, update, and delete decks and cards, enabling automatic flashcard generation from any content in conversation.

connectors.name: Canva Connector
connectors.what_it_does: Connects Canva to Claude chat, enabling users to generate and edit Canva designs directly from within a Claude conversation. Access via Claude → Customize → Connectors → Browse Connectors.
connectors.install_or_source: Claude → Customize → Connectors → Browse Connectors → Canva
